goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear and watch your plot grow, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy upgrades there, press REBIRTH once you can afford it, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The playtester was auto-claimed a plot, bought the Dropper 3 and Speed 1 pads by touch, opened the SHOP and bought several upgrades, and triggered a rebirth through the altar. It never touched the Dropper 2 pad because that pad was untouchable, and it never looked at the TOP TYCOONS board. The rebirth values and affordability checks were inconsistent, so the rebirth part of the goal was not cleanly tested.

bugs.title: Rebirth altar rebirths while the REBIRTH button says it is unaffordable
bugs.evidence: Step 8: the button read 'REBIRTH $80.0K (5%)' and said 'Need $75.9K more' with about $4.5K cash. Step 9: the Golden Altar rebirthed anyway (DropperSlots 3->1; probe rebirths and rebirth_denied counters moved). The two rebirth paths apply different affordability rules.

bugs.title: Rebirth lowers the multiplier and the rebirth cost with no explanation
bugs.evidence: The step 9 rebirth changed RebirthMult from 3 to 1.5 and DropperSlots from 3 to 1. The cost fell from $80K to $10K (step 10 button 'REBIRTH $10.0K', altar '$10000 Next: x2.0'). A rebirth should not reduce the multiplier, and the player is never told why.

bugs.title: Dropper 2 buy pad is stale and untouchable after Dropper 2 is owned
bugs.evidence: Step 3: go_touch on UpgradePad_dropper2 returned 'never touched' (CanTouch=false) although the pad showed '$10 | Step here!'. At steps 4-9 the pad still read 'Step here! $10' while the shop listed Dropper 2 as Owned and Droppers showed 2. A new player following the goal of stepping on the Dropper 2 pad cannot do so.

bugs.title: Pad purchase order is confusing: Dropper 3 and Speed 1 pads were usable before the Dropper 2 pad
bugs.evidence: Steps 1-2: the HUD 'Next' list offered Dropper 3 ($40) and Speed 1 ($20) and they were bought by touch. The Dropper 2 pad ($10) was shown as buyable but could not be touched (step 3). The glowing-pad progression does not match the order the player is told.

bugs.title: Rebirth cost differs between altar label and HUD button, and the session starts with rebirth progress
bugs.evidence: Step 1: the altar showed '$5000 Next: x1.5' while the HUD button showed 'REBIRTH $80.0K'. The probe shows rebirths=5 and rebirth_denied=4, and the playtester reported TotalEarned of about 126K (RebirthMult 3 at step 9) on what should be a fresh new-player session.
